schema: RENOVICE_MISSION_TUNABLE_REGISTRY_V2 tunables[] drafts (contract R14: scaled root-table fields)
note: Every field is re-proven by register_registry.py (mission_owner_specs.rows) with ROOT_TABLE_UPVALUE_V1 against its OWN stock on the pinned 44.0.2 bytes; the row stock is 1 (a multiplier). Array elements name their root LOADN/LOADK instruction (value_instruction); string fields name their table (table_id). Readable line numbers refer to work/research/universal-mission-editor-2026-09-29/decomp/Lotus_Scripts_Modes_ZarimanCorruptionMission.readable.luau.

rows.label: Tank fill speed (deposit rate multiplier)
rows.variant: normal Void Flood (the Shadowgrapher variant deposits all carried energy at once)

limits.basis: multiplier; 0 would stop every tank from filling (minimum 0.05 = 20 times slower); maximum is a numeric guard

rows.evidence: Config table frame_83[18] (root DUPTABLE i25) field depositPctPerSecond = {0.12, 0.09, 0.08, 0.07} (NEWTABLE i26 + SETLIST i31, readable L94-100). Reader: deposit loop prototype 48 (readable L9618-9662): for each player within depositRadius of an unfilled tank, per frame amount = tank.capacity x depositPctPerSecond[frame_83[138]] x dt, limited by the player's carried void energy and by capacity - deposited; frame_83[138] = clamp(players + test clients, 1, 4) (L8325/L8334/L12999/L13684), so the index is the squad size, not the tank. Not read when the Shadowgrapher flag (unresolved global 3420abb0) is set: that variant deposits all carried energy at once (L9599-9616).

rows.label: Tank capacity (void energy per tank multiplier)
rows.variant: normal Void Flood (the Shadowgrapher variant uses fractureCapacity)

limits.basis: multiplier; each capacity is rounded and at least 1; maximum is a numeric guard

rows.evidence: Config table frame_83[18] field capacity = {125, 250, 300, 350} (NEWTABLE i39 + SETLIST i44, readable L106-111), indexed by the human player count (1 to 4). Readers: tank creation prototype 39 (L7095-7115: tank.capacity = capacity[#players]), prototype 2 (L440-455), prototype 43 (L8586-8604: _T.PlayerEnergyCap = capacity[#players], the most void energy a player can carry, in normal mode; the Shadowgrapher variant uses playerCapacity), prototypes 12/33/34. A tank is full at deposited >= capacity (prototype 41 L7712, prototype 48 L9747-9775); deposit per second is capacity x depositPctPerSecond, so the standing time per tank does not change with capacity.

rows.label: Void orb value (energy per orb multiplier)
rows.variant: normal Void Flood (the Shadowgrapher variant uses the Sg amounts)

limits.basis: multiplier; 0 would make orbs worthless; maximum is a numeric guard (carried energy is capped by the tank capacity)

rows.confidence: CONFIRMED_STATIC (R14 owner proof; pickup-module use read from bytecode, decompile unavailable; live pending)
rows.evidence: Config table frame_83[34] (root DUPTABLE i47) fields smallAmt 5, mediumAmt 20, largeAmt 60 (readable L113). Mission start (prototype 68, L13336-13346, normal mode) copies them into _T.VoidPickupAmt = {small, medium, large}; ZarimanCorruptionPickups prototypes 4-7 read VoidPickupAmt (the four orb handlers differ only in one index operand 0/0/1/2) and prototype 0 adds to VoidEnergyCollection; the mission's deposit loop (prototype 48, L9498-9516) moves the collection into the player's carried energy, clamped to _T.PlayerEnergyCap. Prototype 28 (L4404-4425) also uses mediumAmt/smallAmt to split a downed player's dropped energy into orbs. The copy happens at mission start, so a change applies from the next mission.

rows.label: Tank drain speed (Decaying curse drain multiplier)
rows.variant: normal Void Flood while the Decaying curse is active

limits.basis: multiplier; 0 = no drain; maximum is a numeric guard (a tank never drains below 0)

rows.evidence: Config table frame_83[18] field drainPercent 0.08 (readable L94). Reader: tank update prototype 41 (L7724-7840): for a partly filled tank in normal mode, only while curse 5 (frame_83[17][frame_83[190]] with frame_83[190] = 5, the Decaying curse, L10735-10736/L10786) is active and no player is at the tank, every drainInterval (10 s; the first drain 3 s after it starts, L7765) deposited = max(deposited - drainPercent x capacity, 0).
